expected_if_simple_platform_tax_story: marketplace involvement should imply marketplace VAT liability
observed_boundary: BIR states the e-marketplace is not liable when the payment for the digital service is made directly to the NRDSP and is therefore outside marketplace control
analytical_payoff: Direct negative case against treating marketplace presence itself as sufficient; supports operational-control boundary

expected_if_simple_platform_tax_story: platform-mediated seller activity should imply platform withholding
observed_boundary: 2026 government guidance distinguishes platforms with online-ordering/payment functions from platforms without those functions; the latter leave self-declaration/payment duties with the seller under the specified rules
analytical_payoff: Direct functional boundary showing that platform status alone is insufficient for the selected withholding node

expected_if_simple_platform_tax_story: platform intermediation should imply platform VAT liability
observed_boundary: platform liability is conditioned on a continuous process comprising offering service receiving payment and delivering service; provider liability remains relevant outside that platform-controlled portion
analytical_payoff: Direct statutory boundary that separates intermediary presence from sufficiently integrated transaction control

expected_if_simple_platform_tax_story: commercial observability should automatically create collector duty
observed_boundary: the package only treats formal DGT appointment as activating PMSE collector duties; operational presence is not enough by itself
analytical_payoff: Prevents the framework from collapsing observable node into legally liable node; motivates research on appointment criteria

expected_if_simple_platform_tax_story: foreign digital-service provision should imply registration duty for every provider
observed_boundary: the foreign-provider regime applies a qualifying annual threshold before registration is required
analytical_payoff: Shows that node eligibility and fiscal activation are also bounded by statutory thresholds; useful as a scope boundary rather than node-selection proof
